newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Richina cash issue 98.2 pct accepted.
newsitem.headline: Richina cash issue 98.2 pct accepted.

text.p: Leather and theme parks group Richina Pacific Ltd said on Wednesday 98.2 percent of available shares in its recent cash issue had been accepted.
The one for two cash issue of 116.62 million shares at 30 NZ cents was fully underwritten by Richina Enterprise Holdings and a number of subunderwriters.
The number of shares now on issue is 69.97 million following the new allotment and consolidation.
New share certificates will shortly be issued and all previous certificates have been declared void.
The dividend on a pre consolidation pre entitlement basis of 0.5 cents per share is payable May 15, 1997, Richina said.
